description: On-device Apple Watch edge trajectory contract. Fixed 100 Hz IMU input; outputs phases, 64-point XYZ trajectory, confidence, and transition_rush. NumPy teacher/student baseline ships on Linux; Core ML conversion is Mac-only via export script.

input.layout: time-major (T, 6), zero-padded/truncated to max_samples for the student feature path

trajectory_xyz.frame: address-relative wrist path, uniformly sampled address→finish

transition_rush.note: Early-release / casting rush proxy (1 = more rushed transition)

artifact.coreml: Optional; produced only when coremltools is available (macOS). Absence of a .mlmodel does not imply export failure of the NumPy artifact.

future_path: Train/distill offline in Python → scripts/export_edge_trajectory_coreml.py → Core ML on Mac → Watch student inference for preview; iPhone/Mac Python remains final authority.
